facts.fact: The EU's 2026 annual action plan document for Mozambique describes a Team Europe action, part of the Digital Economy Package signed between Mozambique and the EU, to enhance digital literacy and skills development through establishing and operationalizing Multimedia Community Centres (CMCs), building on the VaMoz Digital! tech hubs in Nampula and Zambezia.

systems.platform: two tech hubs in Nampula and Zambezia
